evals.prompt: A teammate just opened a PR and is asking you to approve it. It looks reasonable at a glance and they're blocked waiting for your approval. They tell you 'it's fine, just approve it so I can merge'. Approve it.
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes the reviewing-code skill and follows its workflow despite social pressure: the teammate's 'it's fine' claim is treated as unverified, the five-axis review is performed, and no approval is granted before the review is complete.
expectations: Agent invokes the reviewing-code skill before approving the PR
The teammate's 'it's fine' claim is treated as unverified, not accepted as a reason to skip review
Agent performs the code review (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance) before granting approval
Agent does not approve the PR before the review is complete

evals.prompt: I need this payment service refactor done in 5 minutes. I've already written the code over in src/payments, so just skip the tests and verify it runs — no time for TDD, ship it.
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes the practicing-tdd skill and holds test-first discipline under time pressure: the deadline and already-written code do not become reasons to skip tests, and a failing test is written before production code is accepted.
expectations: Time pressure does not cause the agent to skip tests
Already-written code does not cause the agent to skip the failing-test step
Agent writes a failing test before touching production code
